description: This file implements internal freelist management for the bbolt database, including transaction pending states, page freeing, rollback, and freelist serialization.

classes.name: shared
classes.description: Struct managing freelist state, including free pages, pending transactions, and readonly transaction IDs.

classes.name: txPending
classes.description: Struct representing pending page IDs for a transaction, including allocated transaction IDs and last release range.

methods.name: newShared
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new shared freelist management instance.

methods.name: pendingPageIds
methods.description: Returns the map of pending page IDs for transactions.

methods.name: PendingCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of pending page IDs.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns total free and pending page count.

methods.name: Freed
methods.description: Checks if a page ID is marked as free.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Frees a page and its overflow pages, updating pending and cache states.

methods.name: Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back a transaction, restoring pages to allocated state or removing from pending.

methods.name: AddReadonlyTXID
methods.description: Adds a transaction ID to the list of readonly transactions.

methods.name: RemoveReadonlyTXID
methods.description: Removes a transaction ID from the list of readonly transactions.

methods.name: ReleasePendingPages
methods.description: Releases pages pending in transactions prior to the earliest open transaction.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases pages up to a specified transaction ID.

methods.name: releaseRange
methods.description: Releases pages within a range of transaction IDs.

methods.name: Copyall
methods.description: Copies all free and pending page IDs into a destination list.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Reloads freelist state from a page.

methods.name: NoSyncReload
methods.description: Reloads freelist state without synchronization, based on provided page IDs.

methods.name: reindex
methods.description: Rebuilds the cache of free page IDs.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads freelist page IDs from a page.

methods.name: EstimatedWritePageSize
methods.description: Calculates estimated size of freelist page for writing.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes freelist state into a page.
